newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy offers bonds, certificates for auction.
newsitem.headline: Italy offers bonds, certificates for auction.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said it would issue three, five and 10-year fixed rate bonds (BTP) and seven year floating rate certificates (CCT) at its regular mid-month auction.
The Treasury said in a statement said it would offer:
* 7th tranche 1/11/96 10-yr BTP paying a 7.75 percent coupon.
* 5th tranche 1/09/96 7-yr CCTs paying an initial 3.80 pct coupon.
The amount of paper offered will be announced on Thursday.
Subscriptions for the CCT and 10-year BTP auctions close at 1200 GMT on December 17.
Subscriptions for the three and five year BTP auctions close at 1200 GMT on December 18. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
